newsitem.title: USA: Grease Monkey to open 25 new centers.
newsitem.headline: Grease Monkey to open 25 new centers.

text.p: Grease Monkey Holding Corp said Wednesday it plans to open 25 new centers in Colorado over the next 24 months.
The Colorado expansion is to be developed through the growth of existing franchises, new franchises and company-owned centers.
"This is part of our strategy to create greater critical mass in the markets in which we currently operate," President and Chief Executive Charles Steinbrueck said in a statement.
Grease Monkey is an independent quick lube company and provider of preventive maintenance services for automobiles. There are 218 Grease Monkey centers in the U.S. and Mexico.
